**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Law:** California (Section 14.3) — already at our accepted fallback; left untouched.
- **Forum:** Mandatory single-arbitrator AAA arbitration in San Francisco County fails the fallback requirement that disputes go to the corresponding California courts.
- **Cure (fallback level, 3 surgical ops):** replaced the arbitration mechanic with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in San Francisco County, California; conformed the Section 14.3 heading; and redirected the Section 12.2 escrow dispute cross-reference so no dangling arbitration reference (or orphaned "RULES" definition) survives. No injunctive-relief carve-out or other preferred-level extras were added.
